output.title: Rest and Mobility
output.description: Process: Complete 15 min of full-body tissue release and light mobility → 5 min diaphragmatic breathing in a relaxed supine position. Overall: Full scheduled rest day to dissipate systemic fatigue and prepare the musculoskeletal system for the training week. Reason: Scheduled on Monday to ensure complete physical and neural freshness following previous aerobic loads and ahead of Tuesday quality. Benefit: Facilitates cellular tissue remodeling, glycogen supercompensation, and autonomic nervous system parasympathetic recovery. Warning: Avoid any moderate or high-intensity cross-training or supplementary physical loading today.

output.title: Sub-Threshold Tempo Progression
output.description: Process: Warm up 15 min easy running in Zone 1-2 → 3 x 12 min @ Zone 3 (sub-threshold, 4:40-4:50/km) with 3 min easy jog recovery between reps → Cool down 10 min easy jog in Zone 1. Overall: Specific flat sub-threshold interval session targeting sustained aerobic power and lactate shuttle clearance without crossing into heavy anaerobic glycolysis. Reason: Scheduled in mid-week Build phase to build fatigue resistance in the propelling muscle fibers while respecting the flat training environment. Benefit: Expands functional aerobic capacity and muscular stamina at race intensity without triggering excessive endocrine stress. Warning: Do not exceed 168 bpm (AnT); if breathing becomes ragged or pace slips, terminate the rep immediately to avoid glycolytic exhaustion.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium) sufficient for 70 min duration; take a light carbohydrate snack 60 minutes pre-workout.

output.title: Midweek Aerobic Base Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min brisk walk into easy jog → 45 min continuous steady aerobic running strictly in Zone 2 → Cool down 5 min walking and lower body stretching. Overall: Continuous low-intensity aerobic conditioning run to support mitochondrial density and capillary bed perfusion. Reason: Placed directly following the Tuesday tempo to accumulate aerobic volume while allowing peripheral muscular recovery. Benefit: Enhances free fatty acid oxidation kinetics and reinforces cardiac stroke volume at low cardiovascular cost. Warning: Keep heart rate firmly below 148 bpm (AeT); walk immediately if cardiac drift drives heart rate above the aerobic threshold.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); no exogenous carbohydrate intake is required.

output.title: Home Chassis Stability and Eccentric Control
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min joint mobility and dynamic activation drills → Bodyweight Single-Leg Romanian Deadlifts: 3x10 each leg, 90s rest → Eccentric Box Step-Downs from 30cm bench: 3x10 each leg with controlled 3-second lowering, 90s rest → Walking Lunges: 3x12 each leg, 90s rest → Side Plank with Hip Abduction: 3x30s each side, 60s rest → Cool down 5 min supine hamstring and hip flexor stretches. Overall: Bodyweight strength and eccentric quad preparation designed without gym equipment to mimic descent forces and strengthen pelvic stabilizers. Reason: Scheduled 48 hours away from weekend long efforts to develop structural resilience and eccentric resistance for steep mountain descents. Benefit: Enhances connective tissue stiffness, builds single-leg neuromuscular balance, and shields quads against downhill muscle damage. Warning: Maintain strict pelvic alignment and knee tracking over second toe; avoid allowing knee valgus collapse during single-leg step-downs.
output.fueling_tip: Hydrate with 400-500ml water containing light electrolytes (200mg sodium) post-workout with 20g protein.

output.title: Rest and Preparation
output.description: Process: Perform 10 min gentle foam rolling and soft tissue work → 5 min light mobility for ankles and calves. Overall: Complete rest day to ensure full glycogen saturation and central nervous system freshness before the weekend aerobic endurance block. Reason: Scheduled on Friday to establish a clean physiological buffer between midweek quality/strength and the weekend volume. Benefit: Minimizes chronic fatigue markers, lowers resting muscle tone, and optimizes readiness for the primary long run. Warning: Keep physical exertion strictly to activities of daily living; avoid prolonged standing or fatigue-inducing manual tasks.

output.title: Aerobic Long Run with Neuromuscular Surges
output.description: Process: Warm up 10 min easy jog in low Zone 1-2 → 85 min continuous steady aerobic running in mid Zone 2 → 6 x 20s flat relaxed neuromuscular strides (accelerating smoothly with full recovery) with 90s easy walk/jog between reps → Cool down 10 min easy walk and recovery jog. Overall: Core endurance stimulus of the week developing aerobic threshold pace economy, structural bone density, and neuromuscular recruitment under fatigue. Reason: Weekend long aerobic run delivering sustained time on feet without exceeding the single-session volume ceiling (under 33% of weekly total). Benefit: Up-regulates mitochondrial enzyme production, enhances slow-twitch muscle recruitment, and preserves turnover via end-of-run strides. Warning: Monitor heart rate continuously to ensure effort does not drift into Zone 3 on the flat continuous portion; back off pace immediately if AeT is breached.
output.fueling_tip: Target 30-60g carbohydrates per hour + 300-500mg sodium/hr with 400-600ml water/hr throughout this 115-minute run. Practice consuming trail gels and hydration mix at planned 25-minute intervals.

output.title: Aerobic Recovery Flush Run
output.description: Process: Warm up 5 min gentle walking → 35 min gentle, relaxed running strictly in low Zone 1 → Cool down 5 min walking and lower body mobility. Overall: Very light recovery session designed to stimulate circulation, promote clearance of metabolic byproducts, and cap weekly volume smoothly. Reason: Placed the day after the long run to gently encourage tissue restoration without inducing structural microtrauma. Benefit: Accelerates systemic recovery through increased venous return and light capillary flushing while preserving musculoskeletal integrity. Warning: Do not run at normal training pace; maintain absolute conversational ease where nasal breathing is effortless throughout.
output.fueling_tip: Plain water and optional electrolytes (200-400mg sodium); replenish post-run with balanced carbohydrates and protein.
